## Advanced Billing API
- API Endpoints
  - [List of APIs](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints.md)
  - API Exports
    - [List Exported Proforma Invoices](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/api-exports/list-exported-proforma-invoices.md): Lists exported proforma invoices for a provided `batch_id`.
    - [List Exported Invoices](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/api-exports/list-exported-invoices.md): Lists exported invoices for a provided `batch_id`.
    - [List Exported Subscriptions](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/api-exports/list-exported-subscriptions.md): Lists exported subscriptions for a provided `batch_id`.
    - [Export Proforma Invoices](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/api-exports/export-proforma-invoices.md): Creates a proforma invoices export and returns a batch job object.
    - [Export Invoices](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/api-exports/export-invoices.md): Creates an invoices export and returns a batch job object.
    - [Export Subscriptions](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/api-exports/export-subscriptions.md): Creates a subscriptions export and returns a batch job object.
    - [Read Proforma Invoices Export](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/api-exports/read-proforma-invoices-export.md): Returns a batch job object for a proforma invoices export.
    - [Read Invoices Export](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/api-exports/read-invoices-export.md): Returns a batch job object for an invoices export.
    - [Read Subscriptions Export](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/api-exports/read-subscriptions-export.md): Returns a batch job object for a subscriptions export.
  - Advance Invoice
    - [Issue Advance Invoice](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/advance-invoice/issue-advance-invoice.md): Generate an invoice in advance for a subscription's next renewal date.
    - [Read Advance Invoice](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/advance-invoice/read-advance-invoice.md): Returns the advance invoice generated for a subscription's upcoming renewal.
    - [Void Advance Invoice](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/advance-invoice/void-advance-invoice.md): Void a subscription's existing advance invoice.
  - Billing Portal
    - [Enable Billing Portal for Customer](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/billing-portal/enable-billing-portal-for-customer.md): Enables Billing Portal access for a customer, with an option to send an invitation email at the same time.
    - [Read Billing Portal Link](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/billing-portal/read-billing-portal-link.md): Returns the exact URL required for a subscriber to access the Billing Portal.
    - [Resend Billing Portal Invitation](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/billing-portal/resend-billing-portal-invitation.md): Resends a customer's Billing Portal invitation.
    - [Revoke Billing Portal Access](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/billing-portal/revoke-billing-portal-access.md): Revokes a customer's Billing Portal invitation.
  - Coupons
    - [Create Coupon](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/coupons/create-coupon.md): Creates a coupon under the specified product family.
    - [List Coupons for Product Family](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/coupons/list-coupons-for-product-family.md): Lists coupons for a specific product family in a site.
    - [Find Coupon](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/coupons/find-coupon.md): Searches for a coupon by code, returning a 404 if no coupon is found.
    - [Read Coupon](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/coupons/read-coupon.md): Returns a coupon by its Advanced Billing-assigned ID.
    - [Update Coupon](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/coupons/update-coupon.md): Updates a coupon.
    - [Archive Coupon](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/coupons/archive-coupon.md): Archives a coupon, making it unavailable for future use while remaining active on existing subscriptions.
    - [List Coupons](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/coupons/list-coupons.md): Lists coupons for a site.
    - [Read Coupon Usage](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/coupons/read-coupon-usage.md): Lists coupon usage details, one entry per product.
    - [Validate Coupon](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/coupons/validate-coupon.md): Verifies whether a specific coupon code is valid.
    - [Create or Update Coupon Currency Prices](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/coupons/create-or-update-coupon-currency-prices.md): Creates and/or updates currency prices for an existing coupon.
    - [Create Coupon Subcodes](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/coupons/create-coupon-subcodes.md): Creates subcodes for an existing coupon.
    - [List Coupon Subcodes](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/coupons/list-coupon-subcodes.md): Lists the subcodes attached to a coupon.
    - [Update Coupon Subcodes](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/coupons/update-coupon-subcodes.md): Updates the subcodes for a coupon, replacing all existing subcodes with the new list.
    - [Delete Coupon Subcode](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/coupons/delete-coupon-subcode.md): Deletes a specific subcode from a coupon.
  - Components
    - [Create Metered Component](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/components/create-metered-component.md): Creates a metered component definition under the specified product family.
    - [Create Quantity Based Component](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/components/create-quantity-based-component.md): Creates a Quantity Based component definition under the specified product family.
    - [Create On Off Component](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/components/create-on-off-component.md): Creates an On/Off component definition under the specified product family.
    - [Create Prepaid Usage Component](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/components/create-prepaid-usage-component.md): Creates a prepaid usage component definition under the specified product family.
    - [Create Event Based Component](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/components/create-event-based-component.md): Creates an event-based component definition under the specified product family.
    - [Find Component](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/components/find-component.md): Returns information for a component matching the provided handle.
    - [Read Component](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/components/read-component.md): Returns information regarding a component from a specific product family.
    - [Update Product Family Component](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/components/update-product-family-component.md): Updates a component from a specific product family.
    - [Archive Component](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/components/archive-component.md): Archives the component; all current subscribers will continue to be charged as usual.
    - [List Components](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/components/list-components.md): Lists components for a site.
    - [Update Component](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/components/update-component.md): Updates a component.
    - [List Components for Product Family](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/components/list-components-for-product-family.md): Lists components for a particular product family.
  - Component Price Points
    - [Promote Component Price Point to Default](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/component-price-points/promote-component-price-point-to-default.md): Sets a new default price point for the component.
    - [Create Component Price Point](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/component-price-points/create-component-price-point.md): Creates a price point for an existing component.
    - [List Component Price Points](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/component-price-points/list-component-price-points.md): Lists the price points associated with a component.
    - [Bulk Create Component Price Points](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/component-price-points/bulk-create-component-price-points.md): Creates multiple component price points in one request.
    - [Clone Component Price Point](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/component-price-points/clone-component-price-point.md): Clones a component price point.
    - [Update Component Price Point](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/component-price-points/update-component-price-point.md): Updates a component price point and its associated prices.
    - [Read Component Price Point](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/component-price-points/read-component-price-point.md): Returns details for a specific component price point.
    - [Archive Component Price Point](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/component-price-points/archive-component-price-point.md): Archives a component price point.
    - [Unarchive Component Price Point](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/component-price-points/unarchive-component-price-point.md): Unarchives a component price point.
    - [Create Currency Prices](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/component-price-points/create-currency-prices.md): Creates currency prices for a given currency defined at the site level.
    - [Update Currency Prices](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/component-price-points/update-currency-prices.md): Updates currency prices for a given currency defined at the site level.
    - [List All Component Price Points](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/component-price-points/list-all-component-price-points.md): Lists all component price points belonging to a site.
  - Customers
    - [Create Customer](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/customers/create-customer.md): Creates a new customer; can also be created alongside a new subscription.
    - [List Customers](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/customers/list-customers.md): Lists all customers associated with your site, or filters results using the search parameter.
    - [Read Customer](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/customers/read-customer.md): Retrieves the Customer properties by Advanced Billing-generated Customer ID.
    - [Update Customer](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/customers/update-customer.md): Updates the customer.
    - [Delete Customer](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/customers/delete-customer.md): Deletes the customer.
    - [Read Customer by Reference](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/customers/read-customer-by-reference.md): Returns a customer by their unique reference ID.
    - [List Customer Subscriptions](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/customers/list-customer-subscriptions.md): Lists all subscriptions that belong to a customer.
  - Custom Fields
    - [Create Metafields](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/custom-fields/create-metafields.md): Creates metafields on a Site for either the Subscriptions or Customers resource.
    - [List Metafields](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/custom-fields/list-metafields.md): Lists the metafields and their associated details for a Site and resource type.
    - [Update Metafield](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/custom-fields/update-metafield.md): Updates metafields on your Site for a resource type.
    - [Delete Metafield](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/custom-fields/delete-metafield.md): Deletes a metafield from your Site.
    - [Create Metadata](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/custom-fields/create-metadata.md): Creates metadata and metafields for a specific subscription or customer, or updates metadata values of existing metafields for a subscription or customer.
    - [List Metadata](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/custom-fields/list-metadata.md): Lists metadata and metafields for a specific customer or subscription.
    - [Update Metadata](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/custom-fields/update-metadata.md): Updates metadata and metafields on the Site and the customer or subscription specified, and updates the metadata value on a subscription or customer.
    - [Delete Metadata](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/custom-fields/delete-metadata.md): Deletes one or more metafields (and associated metadata) from the specified subscription or customer.
    - [List Metadata for Resource Type](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/custom-fields/list-metadata-for-resource-type.md): Lists metadata for a specified array of subscriptions or customers.
  - Events
    - [List Events](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/events/list-events.md): Lists events for a site.
    - [List Subscription Events](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/events/list-subscription-events.md): Lists events for a subscription.
    - [Read Events Count](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/events/read-events-count.md): Returns the total count of events for a given site.
  - Events-Based Billing Segments
    - [Create Segment](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/events-based-billing-segments/create-segment.md): Creates a new segment for a component with a segmented metric.
    - [List Segments for Price Point](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/events-based-billing-segments/list-segments-for-price-point.md): Lists segments created for a given price point, in order of creation.
    - [Update Segment](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/events-based-billing-segments/update-segment.md): Updates a single segment for a component with a segmented metric.
    - [Delete Segment](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/events-based-billing-segments/delete-segment.md): Deletes a segment with the specified ID.
    - [Bulk Create Segments](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/events-based-billing-segments/bulk-create-segments.md): Creates multiple segments in one request.
    - [Bulk Update Segments](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/events-based-billing-segments/bulk-update-segments.md): Updates multiple segments in one request.
  - Insights
    - [Read Site Stats](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/insights/read-site-stats.md): Returns basic site-level stats.
    - [Read Mrr](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/insights/read-mrr.md): Returns your site's current MRR, including plan and usage breakouts.
    - [List Mrr Movements](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/insights/list-mrr-movements.md): Lists your site's MRR movements.
    - [List Mrr per Subscription](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/insights/list-mrr-per-subscription.md): This endpoint returns your site's current MRR, including plan and usage breakouts split per subscription.
  - Invoices
    - [Refund Invoice](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/invoices/refund-invoice.md): Refund an invoice, segment, or consolidated invoice.
    - [List Invoices](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/invoices/list-invoices.md): By default, invoices returned on the index will only include totals, not detailed breakdowns for `line_items`, `discounts`, `taxes`, `credits`, `payments`, `custom_fields`, or `refunds`.
    - [Read Invoice](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/invoices/read-invoice.md): Use this endpoint to retrieve the details for an invoice.
    - [List Invoice Events](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/invoices/list-invoice-events.md): This endpoint returns a list of invoice events.
    - [Record Payment for Invoice](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/invoices/record-payment-for-invoice.md): Applies a payment of a given type against a specific invoice.
    - [Record Payment for Multiple Invoices](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/invoices/record-payment-for-multiple-invoices.md): This API call should be used when you want to record an external payment against multiple invoices.
    - [List Credit Notes](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/invoices/list-credit-notes.md): Credit Notes are like inverse invoices.
    - [Read Credit Note](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/invoices/read-credit-note.md): Use this endpoint to retrieve the details for a credit note.
    - [Record Payment for Subscription](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/invoices/record-payment-for-subscription.md): Record an external payment made against a subscription that will pay partially or in full one or more invoices.
    - [Reopen Invoice](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/invoices/reopen-invoice.md): This endpoint allows you to reopen any invoice with the "canceled" status.
    - [Void Invoice](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/invoices/void-invoice.md): This endpoint allows you to void any invoice with the "open" or "canceled" status.
    - [List Consolidated Invoice Segments](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/invoices/list-consolidated-invoice-segments.md): Invoice segments returned on the index will only include totals, not detailed breakdowns for `line_items`, `discounts`, `taxes`, `credits`, `payments`, or `custom_fields`.
    - [Create Invoice](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/invoices/create-invoice.md): This endpoint will allow you to create an ad hoc invoice.
    - [Send Invoice](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/invoices/send-invoice.md): This endpoint allows for invoices to be programmatically delivered via email.
    - [Preview Customer Information Changes](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/invoices/preview-customer-information-changes.md): Customer information may change after an invoice is issued, which may lead to a mismatch between customer information that is present on an open invoice and actual customer information.
    - [Update Customer Information](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/invoices/update-customer-information.md): This endpoint updates customer information on an open invoice and returns the updated invoice.
    - [Issue Invoice](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/invoices/issue-invoice.md): This endpoint allows you to issue an invoice that is in "pending" or "draft" status.
  - Offers
    - [Create Offer](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/offers/create-offer.md): Creates an offer within your Advanced Billing site.
    - [List Offers](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/offers/list-offers.md): Lists offers for a site.
    - [Read Offer](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/offers/read-offer.md): Returns a specific offer's attributes.
    - [Archive Offer](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/offers/archive-offer.md): Archives an existing offer.
    - [Unarchive Offer](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/offers/unarchive-offer.md): Unarchives a previously archived offer.
  - Payment Profiles
    - [Create Payment Profile](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/payment-profiles/create-payment-profile.md): Creates a payment profile for a customer.
    - [List Payment Profiles](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/payment-profiles/list-payment-profiles.md): Returns all active payment profiles for a site, or for one customer within a site.
    - [Read Payment Profile](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/payment-profiles/read-payment-profile.md): Returns a payment profile identified by its unique ID.
    - [Update Payment Profile](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/payment-profiles/update-payment-profile.md): Updates a payment profile.
    - [Delete Unused Payment Profile](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/payment-profiles/delete-unused-payment-profile.md): Deletes an unused payment profile.
    - [Delete Subscriptions Payment Profile](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/payment-profiles/delete-subscriptions-payment-profile.md): Deletes a payment profile belonging to the customer on the subscription.
    - [Verify Bank Account](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/payment-profiles/verify-bank-account.md): Verifies a bank account.
    - [Delete Subscription Group Payment Profile](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/payment-profiles/delete-subscription-group-payment-profile.md): Deletes a Payment Profile belonging to a Subscription Group.
    - [Change Subscription Default Payment Profile](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/payment-profiles/change-subscription-default-payment-profile.md): Changes the default payment profile on the subscription to the existing payment profile with the specified ID.
    - [Change Subscription Group Default Payment Profile](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/payment-profiles/change-subscription-group-default-payment-profile.md): This will change the default payment profile on the subscription group to the existing payment profile with the id specified.
    - [Read One Time Token](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/payment-profiles/read-one-time-token.md): One Time Tokens aka Advanced Billing Tokens house the credit card or ACH (Authorize.Net or Stripe only) data for a customer.
    - [Send Request Update Payment Email](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/payment-profiles/send-request-update-payment-email.md): You can send a "request payment update" email to the customer associated with the subscription.

    - [Schedule Scheduled Renewal Lock In](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/subscription-renewals/schedule-scheduled-renewal-lock-in.md): Schedules a future lock-in date for the renewal.
    - [Lock in Scheduled Renewal Immediately](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/subscription-renewals/lock-in-scheduled-renewal-immediately.md): Locks in the renewal immediately.
    - [Unpublish Scheduled Renewal Configuration](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/subscription-renewals/unpublish-scheduled-renewal-configuration.md): Returns a scheduled renewal configuration to an editable state.
    - [Cancel Scheduled Renewal Configuration](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/subscription-renewals/cancel-scheduled-renewal-configuration.md): Cancels a scheduled renewal configuration.
    - [Create Scheduled Renewal Configuration Item](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/subscription-renewals/create-scheduled-renewal-configuration-item.md): Adds product and component line items to the scheduled renewal.
    - [Update Scheduled Renewal Configuration Item](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/subscription-renewals/update-scheduled-renewal-configuration-item.md): Updates an existing configuration item’s pricing and quantity.
    - [Delete Scheduled Renewal Configuration Item](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/subscription-renewals/delete-scheduled-renewal-configuration-item.md): Removes an item from the pending renewal configuration.
  - Subscription Status
    - [Retry Subscription](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/subscription-status/retry-subscription.md): Retries collecting the balance due on a past-due subscription without waiting for the next scheduled attempt.
    - [Cancel Subscription](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/subscription-status/cancel-subscription.md): Cancels the Subscription.
    - [Resume Subscription](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/subscription-status/resume-subscription.md): Resumes a paused (on-hold) subscription.
    - [Pause Subscription](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/subscription-status/pause-subscription.md): Places the subscription on hold, preventing it from renewing.
    - [Update Automatic Subscription Resumption](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/subscription-status/update-automatic-subscription-resumption.md): Updates the date on which a paused subscription will automatically resume.
    - [Reactivate Subscription](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/subscription-status/reactivate-subscription.md): Reactivates a previously canceled subscription.
    - [Initiate Delayed Cancellation](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/subscription-status/initiate-delayed-cancellation.md): Cancels a subscription at the end of the current billing period based on the subscription's current product.
    - [Cancel Delayed Cancellation](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/subscription-status/cancel-delayed-cancellation.md): Removes the delayed cancellation from a subscription, ensuring it is not canceled at the end of the current period.
    - [Cancel Dunning](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/subscription-status/cancel-dunning.md): Cancels the active dunning process for a subscription and sets it to active.
    - [Preview Renewal](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/subscription-status/preview-renewal.md): Previews a subscription’s next renewal assessment.
  - Webhooks
    - [List Webhooks](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/webhooks/list-webhooks.md): Retrieves a list of webhooks.
    - [Enable Webhooks](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/webhooks/enable-webhooks.md): Enables webhooks for your site.
    - [Replay Webhooks](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/webhooks/replay-webhooks.md): Replays webhooks.
    - [Create Endpoint](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/webhooks/create-endpoint.md): Creates an endpoint and assigns a list of webhook subscriptions (events) to it.
    - [List Endpoints](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/webhooks/list-endpoints.md): Returns created endpoints for a site.
    - [Update Endpoint](https://developers.maxio.com/llms-pages/http/advanced-billing-api/api-endpoints/webhooks/update-endpoint.md): Updates an Endpoint.
